title: AI agents
subtitle: Fifteen agents analyse the platform and raise proposals. They can only read; a person decides.
principle: Each agent declares the data it may read and can only propose. Nothing changes until a member of staff with the right permission approves and applies a proposal — every decision is recorded in the audit log.
noRuns: No run yet. Run the agents to get a first report.

supervision.name: Supervision
supervision.mission: Runs the other agents, detects failed or stale runs and summarises platform health.

catalogue.name: Catalogue
catalogue.mission: Finds published products without images, specifications, translations or any price.

priceAnalysis.name: Price analysis
priceAnalysis.mission: Compares prices with verified market observations and flags negative margins.

stock.name: Stock
stock.mission: Watches low stock, sold-out items still wanted in carts and expired reservations.

promotions.name: Promotions
promotions.mission: Detects expired or overlapping promotions and campaigns that ended or under-perform.

payments.name: Payment monitoring
payments.mission: Spots stuck payments, failure spikes, amount mismatches and unverified webhooks.

finance.name: Financial analysis
finance.mission: Daily revenue and estimated profit summary, refund ratio over 30 days.

flex.name: FLEX follow-up
flex.mission: Tracks overdue and upcoming DOOM FLEX instalments and drafts reminders.

support.name: Customer support
support.mission: Flags tickets waiting beyond the reply target and groups open tickets by topic.

orders.name: Orders
orders.mission: Finds paid orders not processed, unpaid orders and reservations left on cancelled orders.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.mission: Late shipments, express capacity saturation, failed deliveries and open incidents.

server.name: Server monitoring
server.mission: Database latency, agent error rate, private storage size and scheduler freshness.

anomaly.name: Anomaly detection
anomaly.mission: Velocity checks on top-ups and gift cards, unusual order sizes and shared phone numbers.

optimisation.name: Optimisation
optimisation.mission: Slow-moving stock and campaigns that deserve more visibility.

finalAudit.name: Final audit
finalAudit.mission: Ledger reconciliation, audit-log integrity and review of elevated accounts.

inbox.title: Proposals inbox
inbox.subtitle: Review what the agents found. Approve, reject, or apply an approved action.
inbox.results: {count, plural, =0 {No proposal} one {# proposal} other {# proposals}}
inbox.empty: Nothing to review. Run the agents to refresh the analysis.

actionTypes.payment_flag: Flag the payment for manual review (its status and amount do not change).
actionTypes.notification_send: Send the reminder notification to the customer.
actionTypes.reservations_releaseExpired: Release expired stock reservations and cancel the unpaid orders they belong to.
